assets.name: Film grain
assets.description: Luminance-weighted animated grain, cell size and strength parameters (exists in POST_FS; to be exposed per style). Deterministic code or shader functions of (seed, t, parameters); each produces a family of outputs that several styles configure differently.
assets.purpose: One tested implementation instead of one per style; each style owns only its configurations.
assets.references: Existing POST_FS (grain, dither, scan, curve, halftone), lib/kinetic/variety.ts seeded helpers, hash01.
assets.format: GLSL ES 3.0 fragment function in the scene host (GPU tier) plus a Canvas 2D or CPU equivalent where the style has a Clean tier.
assets.dimensions: Resolution independent; evaluated at the render target or a reduced buffer as stated per member.
assets.layer_structure: Outputs a layer (opaque or premultiplied alpha) consumed by a style.
assets.animation: Pure function of t; never stateful between frames.
assets.exclusion_rules: None globally; styles exclude per grammar.
assets.performance: Each member lists its own target in asset-standards.md; reduced-resolution buffers where noted.
assets.acceptance_criteria: Same output for the same inputs on two GPUs within 1/255 per channel on golden frames; no Math.random or Date.now; documented parameter ranges.
assets.variations_not_counted: Every output of a generator is a variation, not an asset; only approved configurations (listed in each style) are counted.
